title: Roadstorm versioned benchmark reference record (reference run schema version 1)
description: Machine-readable contract for a benchmark reference record, defined at M0.9 from docs/BENCHMARKS.md ('Reference driver and records', 'Handling fixtures', 'Numerical comparisons') and the ReferenceRun/Scenario row of docs/TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md 'Content contracts' (fixture and driver revisions, initial state/commands/history, seeds, car/loadout/assist/track/handling hashes, measured traces, eligibility and metric version). A reference record is the measured-evidence half of the benchmark contract: it names the CalibrationDriver and line revisions, the car/loadout/assist and course revisions, the engine/backend/handling revisions, the platform and the seeds it was captured against, fixes the capture protocol (five clean laps per kind after warm-up, rejecting runs with contacts, reset, missed gates, invalid progress or numerical errors), and retains the individual lap times, median, min/max, sector splits, speed samples and content hashes. Reference records are regenerated when those dependencies change. Recorded decision on the two cited documents: docs/TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md 'Content contracts' asks for 'car/loadout/assist/track/handling hashes' while docs/BENCHMARKS.md asks for 'engine/backend/handling/course revisions'; the two conflict, and this contract records the BENCHMARKS wording - car/loadout/assist hashes in results.hashes plus course and handling revisions - as the decision of record, flagged here for the documentation owner rather than silently picking one. Honesty rule: 'status' distinguishes a planned record (authored protocol and dependencies, no results) from a measured record (results captured by tooling) and a superseded one. At M0.9 no measurement exists, so only planned records are authored; the fixtures/scenario validator rejects measured or superseded records inside fixture files, and a planned record must carry no results. A JSON null means 'not yet determined' and MUST be paired with an entry in the enclosing fixture's 'unknowns' (see scenario_fixture.schema.json); an optional member that is absent means 'not applicable'. Provenance is recorded once by the enclosing fixture; a deployed measured record is a standalone evidence artifact that additionally carries its own capture-tool provenance. Companion vocabulary lives in ../common.schema.json; the authored-configuration half of this contract is scenario.schema.json.

schema_version.description: Contract revision identifier. A record whose schema_version differs is rejected, not silently migrated.

kind.description: flying_lap_set: five clean flying laps per car/course revision; it feeds the stock medal thresholds. standing_start_lap_set: five clean standing-start single laps; it feeds Arcade Rush sector budgets (GAME_DESIGN).

status.description: planned = authored protocol and dependencies with no results (the only status authored at M0.9); measured = results captured by M1/M4 tooling against these dependencies; superseded = replaced by a newer record because a dependency changed. The fixtures/scenario validator rejects measured and superseded records inside fixture files: an authored file must not impersonate evidence.

revision.description: Record content revision. Scenarios match a reference by this revision; a dependency change produces a new revision rather than editing measured values.

car_id.description: Car definition ID; the balanced starter is car.balanced_starter.

car_display_name.description: Current display name for readability; stable IDs survive name changes (BENCHMARKS).

loadout.description: Loadout captured. The standard medal session uses the balanced starter at levels 0/0/0, i.e. stock; other combinations retain separate records.

course_revision.description: Course content revision captured. null while course content is unratified (M2); a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

kind.description: BENCHMARKS: the reference driver is the fixed, versioned, traffic-free path follower with no tactical planner, learning, difficulty scaling or random mistakes. Using an evaluated AI difficulty as its own reference is not allowed.

traffic_free.description: The reference capture runs with no traffic.

driver_revision.description: Revision of the CalibrationDriver controller code. null until M1.7; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

reference_line_revision.description: Revision of the authored line and conservative speed profile the driver follows. null until M1; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

engine_revision.description: Pinned engine revision (Godot 4.7.2 Standard at M0.1). null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

physics_backend.description: M0 pins the built-in Jolt 3D backend; a backend change is a handling revision.

handling_revision.description: Motor/car/surface handling revision captured. null until M1 freezes handling; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

metric_version.description: Revision of the metric definitions the record is evaluated under (docs/BENCHMARKS.md).

platform.description: Hardware/OS the capture ran on; BENCHMARKS requires retaining the platform with each record. null until the capture machine is recorded; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

warmup_laps.description: Warm-up laps before the recorded laps. BENCHMARKS says 'after warm-up' without fixing a count, so this is null until ratified; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

required_clean_laps.description: Five clean flying laps and five clean standing-start single laps per car/course revision (BENCHMARKS 'Reference driver and records').

rejection_criteria.description: Run-rejection criteria: reject runs with contacts, reset, missed gates, invalid progress or numerical errors. The validator requires all five (see $defs.constants).

laps.description: Individual recorded laps, clean and rejected. Empty in a planned record: no lap has been captured yet.

median_s.description: Median over the clean lap times. null in a planned record; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

min_s.description: Fastest clean lap time. null in a planned record; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

max_s.description: Slowest clean lap time. null in a planned record; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

statistics.description: Retained summary statistics over the clean laps (BENCHMARKS).

speed_samples.description: Retained speed samples along the lap. Empty in a planned record.

car_hash.description: Hash of the car definition captured. null in a planned record; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

loadout_hash.description: Hash of the loadout captured. null in a planned record; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

assist_hash.description: Hash of the assist set captured. null in a planned record; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

hashes.description: Car/loadout/assist hashes retained with the record (BENCHMARKS).

seeds.description: Seeds the capture ran with, retained with the record (BENCHMARKS).

bronze_multiplier.description: Initial Bronze threshold factor times the measured flying-lap median (BENCHMARKS).

bronze_s.description: 1.25 x the measured flying-lap median. null until measured (or on a standing-start record, where medal thresholds do not apply); a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

silver_s.description: 1.12 x the measured flying-lap median. null until measured; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

gold_s.description: 1.05 x the measured flying-lap median. null until measured; a null requires a fixture unknowns entry.

derived_thresholds.description: Initial stock-medal thresholds for the balanced starter, tuned after captured play with the final values recorded (BENCHMARKS). Medal thresholds derive from the flying-lap median; Arcade Rush budgets derive from the standing-start record's sector times (GAME_DESIGN).

superseded_by.description: Record ID that replaced this one because a dependency changed. Absent unless status is superseded.

time_s.description: Lap time in seconds; retained even for a rejected lap, which is excluded from the median/min/max. null only while the record is unmeasured.

clean.description: Whether the lap met the clean-run policy (no contact, reset, missed gate, invalid progress or numerical error).

invalid_reason.description: Required when clean is false; must be one of the capture protocol's rejection criteria.

sector_splits_s.description: Four sector splits (GAME_DESIGN). Arcade Rush sector budgets are built from the standing-start record's sector times. Optional in this schema because a rejected lap may not retain them, but the fixtures/scenario validator requires exactly four splits on every clean lap of a measured record: BENCHMARKS 'Reference driver and records' retains sector splits with each record.

constants.description: Single source of truth for the numeric protocol of this contract, all from docs/BENCHMARKS.md (with the Arcade Rush factors from docs/GAME_DESIGN.md). The fixtures/scenario validator reads these instead of restating them.

rejection_criteria.description: BENCHMARKS: reject runs with contacts, reset, missed gates, invalid progress or numerical errors.

arcade_rush_factors.description: Initial Arcade Rush budget factors per difficulty (GAME_DESIGN): b_i = factor * reference_sector_seconds + measured_mistake_margin_i, rounded to milliseconds.
